response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong software development skills and a broad technical background, but his experience is heavily skewed toward web, full-stack, and scripting languages (TypeScript, Node.js, JavaScript) rather than the C++-centric, industrial automation focus required for this role. While he has some exposure to low-latency systems and embedded development, his recent work lacks direct alignment with the core competencies of high-performance C++ applications, secure development lifecycle (SDL), or industrial cybersecurity standards like IEC 62443.
strengths: Extensive experience in software craftsmanship, including test-driven development (TDD), agile methodologies, and cross-functional collaboration.
Diverse technical background with exposure to low-latency systems, event-driven architectures, and distributed systems (e.g., DLang at Sociomantic, GISCollective platform).
Strong mentorship and knowledge-sharing track record, including workshops, talks, and open-source contributions (e.g., Fluent-Asserts, Trial).
concerns: Limited recent hands-on experience with C++ (last noted in 2015 at National Instruments), raising questions about proficiency in modern C++ standards and STL.
Primary expertise lies in web and full-stack development (TypeScript, Node.js, React), which is not directly relevant to the role’s focus on industrial automation and secure C++ applications.
No explicit mention of secure development lifecycle (SDL) practices, industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443), or experience with industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA).
